rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something gives off its own light.
Use this specifically when a surface or object reflects light rather than producing it.

example.english: The glass reflects light so brightly that I can't see clearly, and everything seems to shine.
example.traditional: 塊玻璃反光反到我睇唔清楚。
example.jyutping: faai3 bo1 lei1 faan2 gwong1 faan2 dou3 ngo5 tai2 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this when a person shines by performing exceptionally well.
